# VINASIG Design System

> A draft, AI-readable source of shared UI guidance for VINASIG websites. All rules are proposals pending approval.

Start with the repository's `AGENTS.md` for agent instructions and project context. Read the source specification linked for the task; do not assume draft rules are approved policy.

## Published guides

- [Overview](/): purpose and current status.
- [Foundations](/foundations/): color, typography, spacing, responsive behavior, and accessibility.
- [Components](/components/): buttons, text inputs, status messages, and cards.
- [Patterns](/patterns/): forms, empty states, loading, errors, and page layout.
- [AI agent guide](/agents/): how an agent should use this system.

## Source files

- `AGENTS.md`: project context and working rules.
- `docs/foundations/README.md`: foundation specification.
- `docs/components/README.md`: component specification.
- `docs/patterns/README.md`: pattern specification.
- `src/styles/tokens.css`: implemented CSS design tokens.
